claims.claim: We also deals on all kinds of car spare parts
claims.evidence: Witness report only shows motorcycle engine assemblies/components; no evidence about the seller’s business scope.

risks.risk: Exact make/model compatibility is unknown, so the engine may not fit the buyer’s motorcycle or may require extra parts.
risks.proof: A clear shot of the engine identification plate/stamping (engine number) and/or the full motorcycle model/year it came from.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as an unknown motorcycle engine assembly with compatibility risk (worst-case: may be non-matching/needs parts).

risks.risk: Working condition is unknown (compression/running status, leaks, missing internal parts).
risks.proof: Video/clip of the engine being started and running (or a compression test reading) plus close-ups of any suspected leaks/cracks.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as not proven working (worst-case: for parts/repair only).

risks.risk: Completeness is unknown—may be missing covers, sensors, wiring, carburetor/injector, starter/alternator, or other required components.
risks.proof: A full laid-out inventory photo showing every included component, and a shot of the engine fully assembled with all external parts present.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as incomplete/unknown completeness (worst-case: missing key parts).

risks.risk: Damage beyond what’s shown (cracks, stripped threads, bent shafts, warped cylinder head) could exist.
risks.proof: Close-up shots of cylinder head surfaces, mounting points, crank/shaft ends, and any visible cracks/threads; plus a test/inspection report if available.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as potentially damaged (worst-case: requires major repair).

risks.risk: Disassembly suggests possible prior failure; parts may be mismatched or from different units.
risks.proof: A clip showing the exact foreground engine assembly as a single unit (not mixed parts), with matching labels/markings if present.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as a disassembled/possibly mixed assembly (worst-case: not a matched set).

proof_requests: Send a clear photo of the engine number/ID plate (and any stamping) so we can confirm make/model compatibility.
Provide a short video of the engine starting/running, or a compression test result.
Show a complete parts list: what is included (carb/injector, wiring harness, sensors, starter/alternator, covers) with photos of each item.
Send close-ups of cylinder head and block for cracks/warping, and mounting points/threads for damage.
response.reason: The witness report consistently identifies the item as a motorcycle engine assembly/components, so it can be priced at the worst-case for unknown compatibility and unproven working condition. Missing make/model, completeness, and test results are treated as risks that keep the price conservative.
